page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with the closing word FINIS and the heading INDEX below it. Running head at top. Page number at top left. No marginal notes. Show-through and stains at the right edge.

main_text.p: bem gressus ferebat, pleriq; anfractuosi ac difficiles, etiam cum muro non clauderetur. Imminebat urbi ab oriente Taygetus mons præruptus & excelsus ea parte, ex Arcadiæ finibus veniens, & Laconiam totam pene usque ad mare meridiem versus percurrens, sed non pari altitudine, sæpe etiam valde subsidens, & propemodum intermissus. Ad cujus radices labebatur fluvius Eurotas, gelidus,profundus,aquis majorem anni partem abundans, in eadem Arcadia juxta Alphæi fluminis alterius totâ Peloponnefo celeberrimi fontes ortus, & Laconiam à septentrione ingressus longoque tractu versus meridiem defluens, qua Spartam prætervehebatur, Taygeti radice radens, non longius sesquistadio ab eo in ortum distabat: dein reliquam regionem permeans in sinum maris, qui inter promontoria Maleam & Tænarum fundebatur, non procul Gytheo exibat.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The printed "Peloponnefo" and "fundebatur" are kept as printed. Nothing in the right margin is printed text: the marks there are show-through and stains. The dash before INDEX is a mark, not a printed character. Nothing printed below INDEX.
